# Retrospective: PR #12860

## Worked

Fresh native technical sessions, equivalent neutral scope, independent command-only runtime evidence and baseline controls fit this narrow change well. Both reviewers independently found the same concrete logging blind spot without generic test filler. The coordinator read complete reports and source/evidence before synthesis. No desktop resources were needed.

## Friction and corrections

Fable's first diagnostic probe also affected explicit-package behavior, so an earlier existing assertion caught it. The preserved first run is not proof about the new stripped-environment assertion. A second, narrowed mutation demonstrated the intended blind spot with corrected-test and clean-head controls. Astra independently reproduced the same weakness. Future assignments should explicitly isolate a diagnostic mutation to the contract under study and retain failed-to-isolate probes as limited evidence.

Astra initially requested an artifact filename that did not exist, then read the correct stderr.log. No runtime case or conclusion depended on the failed lookup. Use runner-recorded artifact names rather than assumed names.

Bounded lifecycle waits timed out while reviewers progressed; one tool-level wait timed out shortly before Fable was observed done. No prompt was blindly repeated and no agent was interrupted.

## Deviations and evidence integrity

No observed safety, independence, session-reset, sandbox or publication deviation. All probes were isolated, private mutation roots were asserted, raw outputs and child exits were retained, and only completed owned resources were cleaned. Initial diagnostic limitations were preserved, not hidden. Read-only public issue research is permitted document research. No tool bug is established by these ordinary investigation corrections.

The pre-existing update-available issue was included only after source/raw-evidence adjudication, explicitly conditional on reaching that stage. The stronger claim that the live update indicator was cleared was not made. No full update was run.

## Carry forward

Keep environment-independent dependency logging for env -i fixtures. Include helper-level baseline controls and concrete mutation controls when testing a no-call assertion. Distinguish a fixed helper from an entirely validated update pipeline. Retain saved native identities and independent reports; do not carry conclusions into the next PR. Coordinator waits for outer reset and does not select new work.
comment:
**Verified:** At `58a9479a91a8`, both changed helpers handle an unset `OMARCHY_PATH` without the original nounset abort. Their new regression cases fail against the baseline and pass against the PR. No regression was found in the changed production code; the same unset-variable issue remains in a later update helper.

| Unset `OMARCHY_PATH` | Baseline | PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `omarchy-update-dev` | Unbound-variable error | Exit 0, no Git call |
| `omarchy-channel-current` | Unbound-variable error | Resolves the supplied package channel |

## Remaining pre-existing nounset failure in update-status

[`omarchy-update-available:9`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/58a9479a91a89010b8f3553d7d23dfa1931d4049/bin/omarchy-update-available#L9) still compares bare `$OMARCHY_PATH` under `set -u`. Running that helper with the variable absent still exits 1 with `OMARCHY_PATH: unbound variable`.

```text
Inspected update call chain, if execution reaches status:
omarchy-update
  -> omarchy-update-status
     -> omarchy-update-available: nounset error, exit 1
     -> selects the shell's "clear" branch, not "refresh"
```

**Impact:** The missing environment variable is treated like “no updates available” without checking updates. This is a pre-existing, non-fatal condition failure, not a regression introduced by the PR. The helper failure and branch selection were reproduced; the full update and actual shell indicator were not exercised.

**Suggested change:** Apply the same `${OMARCHY_PATH:-/usr/share/omarchy}` fallback to this helper's initial comparison.

**Optional test improvement:** In `test/shell.d/update-dev-test.sh:64`, forward `TEST_GIT_LOG="$git_log"` through `env -i`. Without it, a diagnostic Git call added only to the unset-path branch still passes the “invokes no git” assertion because the stub loses its log destination. Supplying the logger makes that diagnostic case fail while the unmodified helper still passes. This is test-only; the PR helper itself made no Git call.

## Review information

**Test scope:** Targeted shell tests and baseline/head helper execution with synthetic Git, package and channel dependencies, including explicit package/dev paths. No real sudo/cron invocation, package upgrade, Git remote, desktop indicator, full update or full test suite was exercised.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra initial source inspection, independent Fable 5.1 High and Astra Xhigh technical reviews, followed by Astra synthesis against source and targeted execution evidence.
